name: Sopa de Lentejas
summary: Mexican-style green lentil soup with potato, carrot, and tomato, served with corn tortillas and lime.
instructions: Heat the oil in a large pot over medium heat. Cook the onion and carrot 5 minutes, then add the garlic, cumin, and oregano for 1 minute.
Add the tomatoes and cook 3 minutes.
Add the lentils, broth, 750 mL water, and bay leaf. Bring to a boil, then simmer 20 minutes.
Add the potatoes and simmer 15 minutes more until the lentils and potatoes are soft. Season with salt.
Serve with lime wedges and warm tortillas.

glutenFree.notes: Lentils, vegetables, and spices are naturally gluten-free. Corn tortillas are naturally gluten-free, but a few brands add wheat flour. Check the label. Check the broth label.

budgetNotes: Green lentils hold their shape better than red ones, which turn to mush in this soup.
Some versions add a few slices of bacon at the start. One or two slices is enough.
Freezes well and tastes better the next day.
